completion_suitability.description: Checks repetition and rhyming patterns in the story.

criteria: Question focuses on repeated phrases or rhymes.
Child can answer using completion of a known pattern.

recall_suitability.description: Assesses the ability to recall story events or sequences.

wh_suitability.description: Targets factual questions about story details.

criteria: Question is answerable from the story context.

distancing_suitability.description: Bridges story content with the child's own experiences.

criteria: Connects the story to real-world analogues.
